claims.label: Candace Owens journaled to Charlie Kirk throughout the year following his death
claims.claim: The host reads aloud journal entries she wrote to Charlie Kirk across the year after his death, saying she is sharing only some of her journaling.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify continuity of journal entries against timestamps and corroborating events referenced.

claims.label: Mappin family open letter calls Charlie's death an "execution" with "far-reaching international consequences"
claims.claim: Irina and John Mappin co-authored an open letter, which the host reads, stating that Charlie's death was "an assassination with potentially far-reaching political consequences" and asserting that "the truth, when known… will have far-reaching international consequences."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original publication of the open letter and verify signatures.

claims.label: Mappin letter asserts official investigation should be ordered to share information with Candace's team
claims.claim: The open letter states that "the official investigation should be immediately ordered by the appropriate legal authority to proactively share everything they know with Candace and her selected team."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify letter text and any official response from investigative authorities.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk wrote a text message describing his future wife as "paralyzing" and "the ideal"
claims.claim: A quoted text message from Charlie Kirk reads (in part): "She has no freaking clue how paralyzing she is to me. And she is the ideal."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify original text-message record and date against Charlie Kirk's device backups or testimony.

claims.label: Kanye West texted Candace Owens "it's a battle cry to be yourself" in response to a question about "Power"
claims.claim: Host quotes a direct text reply from Kanye West following Charlie's death: when asked why he wrote the song "Power," he wrote back "it's a battle cry to be yourself."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify text record; cross-reference against any public statement from Kanye.

claims.label: Kanye West publicly tweeted "I love the way Candace Owens thinks" in approximately April–May 2018
claims.claim: Host references a Kanye West tweet from April–May 2018 reading "I love the way Candace Owens thinks."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original tweet via archive; verify date and any follow-up replies. *Artifact verbally referenced but not shown in episode.*

claims.label: Donald Trump posted a tweet featuring a mock Time magazine cover calling Candace Owens "most vile person of the year"
claims.claim: Host reports that Donald Trump tweeted a mock-up of a Time magazine cover depicting her as "the most vile person of the year."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original tweet via archive. *Artifact verbally referenced but not shown in episode.*

claims.label: Candace Owens attended Ye's Chicago concert during the week of Charlie's one-year anniversary, where Kid Cudi appeared on stage
claims.claim: Host reports that she attended Ye's Chicago concert during the week of the anniversary, at which Kid Cudi was brought on stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm concert date and Kid Cudi's set via tour documentation.

claims.label: Host reports a "scheduled will change" regarding Charlie Kirk's estate
claims.claim: Host asserts in her written journal: "I know about the scheduled will change."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain probate records and any will amendments filed in relevant jurisdiction.

claims.label: Host Reports Charlie Kirk Purchased a House in the Suburbs that Erika Kirk Avoided Moving Into
claims.claim: Host asserts in journal that Charlie "purchased and dreamed about moving into" a suburban house and that Erica "came up with a million excuses not to."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify property records and timeline of acquisition vs. residence.

claims.label: Host reports Ben Shapiro arrived at Charlie Kirk's studio within days of his death with $1 million claiming to "pick up the bloody mic"
claims.claim: Host asserts in journal that Ben Shapiro "slid into your studio within days, $1 million in hand," publicly stating he would "pick up your bloody mic."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate contemporaneous reporting on Shapiro's actions and any public statement. *No external corroborating artifact presented in episode.*

claims.label: Host reports breaking her foot during the year since Charlie Kirk's death
claims.claim: Host states in journal that "I broke my foot" between the Wyoming entry and the present.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify medical or insurance records if relevant to investigation.

claims.label: Host reports being approximately eight months pregnant at time of recording
claims.claim: Host states she is "8 months pregnant" at the time of recording.
claims.investigative_direction: Not investigationally material; recorded for biographical record.
claims.transcript_snippet: And obviously I wish I also wasn't 8 months pregnant doing this when I'm already in a heightened emotional state.

claims.label: Host reports she first belly laughed since Charlie Kirk's death while in Spain
claims.claim: Host states she first experienced a deep belly laugh since Charlie's death while in Spain.
claims.investigative_direction: Not investigationally material; recorded for biographical record.

claims.label: Host reports Charlie Kirk's memorial featured Susie Wiles speaking and was characterized as "like an RNC rally"
claims.claim: Host states in journal that Charlie's memorial was "weird," "like an RNC rally," with Susie Wiles among speakers.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify speaker list and video documentation of memorial event.

claims.label: Host reports Charlie Kirk told her in April–May 2018 he had dreamed his own death and its connection to Turning Point USA
claims.claim: Host states in journal that in April–May 2018 Charlie told her "with absolute certainty" he had dreamed his death, that it would be associated with Turning Point USA, and that he would not live to see "this thing through."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against any contemporaneous recording, communication, or corroborating witness.

claims.label: Ye performed in Chicago for the first time in six years during the week of Charlie Kirk's anniversary
claims.claim: Host states Ye "returned to Chicago… during the week of your anniversary" after six years.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via Ye tour itinerary and prior concert dates.

claims.label: Kid Cudi and Kanye West had a public falling out in 2022
claims.claim: Host states that Ye and Kid Cudi "had a massive public falling out in 2022."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via public reporting.

claims.label: Mappin letter characterizes Candace's investigative actions as "providential, divinely inspired, and metaphysical"
claims.claim: The open letter states Candace's actions are "actions of the highest order of patriotism," "service to the whole country and to the world," and "truly providential, divinely inspired, and metaphysical."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify letter text and signatories.

claims.label: Host reports the "Ace team" told her the movie 300 "beautiful death" scene inspired a portion of Kanye West's "Power"
claims.claim: Host states that when meeting with the "Ace team," they explained that the inspiration behind the "beautiful death" portion of the song came from a specific scene in the movie 300.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with the named team or any documentation of the meeting. *Possible transcription error: "Ace team" identity unclear.*

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Ignored Her Warning That Running 10 Miles Daily Would Injure His Back
claims.claim: The host says in her journal that she warned Charlie Kirk that running 10 miles every day was too much for his body and that he later injured his back.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for contemporaneous accounts or Kirk's own public remarks about a back injury and his running routine.
claims.transcript_snippet: When I told you that running 10 miles every single day was too much on your body, that you were going to get injured.

claims.label: Host Says Her Priest Told Her Charlie Is Likely in Purgatory
claims.claim: The host says her priest told her Charlie Kirk is likely in purgatory and that she needs to pray for his soul.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal religious statement; only the host can confirm what her priest said.
claims.transcript_snippet: My priest tells me that you're likely in purgatory, and that I need to pray for your soul.

claims.label: Host Says She Told George Charlie Was Betrayed Before His Death Was Confirmed
claims.claim: The host says that before it was confirmed Charlie Kirk had died, she told her husband George while they prayed in his office that they had betrayed him, and that George replied they did not know anything yet.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host and George for the date and circumstances of the conversation, and look for any message or call log from that morning.
claims.transcript_snippet: You know, before we even found out that you didn't make it, I knew you were betrayed.

claims.label: Host Says She Senses They Wanted Her to See Charlie Die
claims.claim: The host says she has a deep sense that unnamed persons wanted her to see Charlie Kirk die and that the way the footage was broadcast globally makes no sense.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host what evidence supports the sense that the broadcast was intended; compare with platform moderation statements and viral spread timelines for the footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have this deep sense that uh they wanted me to see you die.

claims.label: Host Says Platform Violence Filters Malfunctioned on September 10
claims.claim: The host says the footage of Charlie Kirk's shooting defied algorithmic norms and that Facebook, TikTok and X all failed at the same time to remove violent content they are built to catch.
claims.investigative_direction: Request moderation logs, takedown timelines and policy statements from Meta, TikTok and X for the first hours after the shooting; check whether they published any account of the failure.
claims.transcript_snippet: Facebook, TikTok, X, suddenly all of their preventative measures that are designed to catch and remove violence from their platforms immediately malfunctioned that day.

claims.label: Host Says She Stopped Eating After Charlie's Death
claims.claim: The host says she had not had a spell of anorexia since her early twenties but stopped eating after Charlie Kirk's death and went to Wyoming to get away.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal health disclosure by the host about herself; no investigative record applies.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had not had a spell of anorexia since my early 20s, but the very first thing I did was I just stopped eating.

claims.label: Host Says She Floated Witness Protection to George Before Accepting Charlie Was Dead
claims.claim: The host says she told George that perhaps Charlie Kirk was in witness protection and that George answered that he thought Charlie was dead.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal recollection by the host; only the host and George can confirm it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe he's in witness protection.

claims.label: Host Says People Who Hated Charlie Sold T-Shirts and Mugs in His Name
claims.claim: The host says people in the political sphere who hated Charlie Kirk sold t-shirts and mugs in his name after his death.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the vendors and products the host means; compare with the existing TPUSA post-assassination merchandise revenue claim.
claims.transcript_snippet: people who hated you, selling t-shirts and mugs in your name.

claims.label: Host Says Irina and John Mappin Attended the Memorial and Irina Heard Many Russian Speakers
claims.claim: The host says Irina and John Mappin attended Charlie Kirk's memorial and that Irina told her she had never seen so many people speaking her native Russian in Arizona.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the Mappins for a first-hand account; compare with attendee lists, seating and credentialing for the Glendale memorial.
claims.transcript_snippet: she told me that she had never seen so many people speaking her native language, Russian, in Arizona.

claims.label: Mappin Letter Says Crime Scene Was Destroyed in Days
claims.claim: The host reads a letter from the Mappins saying a crime scene was apparently completely destroyed in days and that there is plenty of evidence that does not add up.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the published letter and compare the wording; check Utah Valley University scene-release and cleanup records.
claims.transcript_snippet: A crime scene apparently completely destroyed in days, and plenty of evidence that simply does not add up.

claims.label: Mappin Letter Says Convicting Anyone With Any Doubt Is Anathema to Christ
claims.claim: The host reads a letter saying that a conviction and death sentence while any shadow of doubt remains would be anathema to the teachings of Christ.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the published letter; record whether the signers name Tyler Robinson or the Utah prosecution directly.
claims.transcript_snippet: The very idea that someone could be convicted and could receive the death penalty when there remains even the slightest shadow of doubt

claims.label: Mappin Letter Says Candace Has an Army of Truth Seekers Worldwide
claims.claim: The host reads a letter saying she has an army of truth seekers worldwide helping her search and research, which the letter calls new and modern.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the published letter; the claim about volunteer contributors can be compared with the host's tip submissions.
claims.transcript_snippet: She has an army of truth seekers worldwide who are helping her in her search and research.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Clip Says He Started the Organization at 18 and Was Raised in Chicago
claims.claim: An audio montage played by the host includes Charlie Kirk saying he started the organization at 18 years old and was born and raised in Chicago, Illinois.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source interview of the clip and its date; the facts match Kirk's public biography.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, I started this organization when I was 18 years old. Born and raised in Chicago, Illinois.

claims.label: Host Says Investigating Erika Kirk Made Her Public Enemy Number One
claims.claim: The host says that since the first entry she has become public enemy number one for investigating Charlie Kirk's wife.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile the public attacks on the host by TPUSA figures and allies after the investigation began.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm also public enemy number one for investigating your wife.

claims.label: Host Says the World Was Right About Erika Kirk
claims.claim: The host says she wanted the world to be wrong about Erika Kirk but that they were right, and that coming to terms with it broke her.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host what specific findings she means; map to the claims in the earlier registers.
claims.transcript_snippet: I really wanted the world to be wrong about her, but they they were not. They were right.

claims.label: Charlie Text Says Erika Putting Him in a Weird Cage Gave TPUSA Its Most Successful Months
claims.claim: The host reads a text she attributes to Charlie Kirk saying his future wife's treatment of him had given Turning Point the most successful few months ever and that it was an effort to impress the girl across the street, like the Tom Sawyer story.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full text thread and its date from the host; compare with TPUSA fundraising and growth reporting for the period.
claims.transcript_snippet: In a funny way, her putting me in this weird cage and box actually has given to TPOSA the most successful few months ever.

claims.label: Host Says a Wife Would Not Partner With Your Enemies
claims.claim: The host says she does not know what Erika Kirk is but knows that a wife would not partner with Charlie Kirk's enemies.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host which partnerships she means; compare with Erika Kirk's dealings with people the host says opposed Charlie.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know that a wife would not partner with your enemies.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Has Chased Power Her Whole Life
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk has been chasing power her entire life and that she thinks this is why she will never have the real kind.
claims.investigative_direction: Opinion about Erika Kirk's character; check biographical record for the career moves the host may be citing.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know now that her entire life she has been chasing power.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Told Her They Would Not Kill Her but Would Make Stuff Up and Attack Family
claims.claim: The host says that in spring 2018 Charlie Kirk told her not to fear death, that she was sent to fix things, that they would not kill her, and that they would make things up and then try to attack family, which would not work either.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for a contemporaneous message, recording or third party who heard Kirk say this in April or May 2018.
claims.transcript_snippet: Don't fear death. Embrace it or else you'll lose your mind. You were sent here to fix things. They won't let it happen. They won't kill you.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Claims She First Saw Charlie at an Airport
claims.claim: The host says that Erika Kirk claims the first time she laid eyes on Charlie Kirk was at an airport but that she chose not to approach him and the host.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Erika Kirk's own telling of how she first saw Charlie; locate the 2018 Israel trip dates and flight records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Your future wife claims that this is the first time she laid eyes on you at an airport, but she chose not to go up to us.

claims.label: Host Says She and Charlie Were in Israel About Two Weeks After Visiting Kanye
claims.claim: The host says that after Kanye West's tweet about her in 2018, she and Charlie Kirk flew out to see him, and that about two weeks after that they were standing in Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Check dates of the Kanye tweet and the 2018 Israel trip with travel records or photographs.
claims.transcript_snippet: We fly out to see him in just 2 weeks after that, you and I are standing in Israel.

claims.label: Host Says Meeting George on an Unplanned London Trip Saved Her Life
claims.claim: The host says she felt a spiritual pull to be in London in 2018, told Charlie they needed to be there and that he had to find a reason to get them there, and that meeting George on that unplanned trip saved her life.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the host's earlier accounts of how she met George and the dates of the 2018 London trip.
claims.transcript_snippet: Meeting George in unplanned trip saved my life.

claims.label: Host Says Kanye Won the Grammy for Best Rap Album for My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy
claims.claim: The host says Kanye West's album soared to number one and took home a Grammy for best rap album for My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Grammy Awards records for the 2012 ceremony.
claims.transcript_snippet: He took home a Grammy for best rap album, for My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fan- Fantasy.

claims.label: Host Says the Word Exciting in Power Turns Into Suicide
claims.claim: The host says that listening closely, the word exciting in the Power lyric turns into suicide, which she reads as Kanye West's struggle to stay true to himself.
claims.investigative_direction: Interpretive reading of a song lyric; compare with the album's lyric sheet and audio.
claims.transcript_snippet: the word exciting actually turns into suicide.

claims.label: Host Says the Whole World Knows Charlie Was Under Immense Political Pressure With Israel
claims.claim: The host says the whole world knows Charlie Kirk was under immense political pressure with Israel, that he was surrounded and that his life became the Truman Show.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile documents or witnesses on pressure applied to Kirk about Israel; compare with the host's earlier claims about donor and Netanyahu contacts.
claims.transcript_snippet: the whole world knows that you were under immense political pressure with Israel.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Never Let Her Drive and Set the Restroom Stops
claims.claim: The host says she will miss Charlie Kirk never letting her drive and mandating when they could stop for restroom breaks.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal anecdote; the played clip is the only corroboration.
claims.transcript_snippet: mandating when we were allowed to stop for restroom breaks.

claims.label: Host Relays a Person's Remark That Charlie Knew He Had Helped Create a Monster
claims.claim: The host relays what an unnamed person told her a couple of weeks earlier: that in the end Charlie Kirk knew he had accidentally helped create a monster and was unsure he had the strength to do what needed to be done, and she reflects on the pressure of his final days and a final decision.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who made the remark and what monster and decision they meant; compare with the host's other accounts of Kirk's last days.
claims.transcript_snippet: in the end you knew that you had accidentally helped create a monster and you weren't sure if you had the strength to do what needed to be done

claims.label: Host Says the New Narrative Portrays Charlie as Loomer's Friend and a Neocon Fan
claims.claim: The host says in a sarcastic passage that those reimagining Charlie Kirk's life now portray him as friends with Laura Loomer, as having loved neocons and as not favoring Tucker Carlson, while he hated her.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Kirk's recorded statements about Loomer, Carlson and the host, and with TPUSA's post-death messaging.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think you're now friends with Laura Loomer, Charlie.

claims.label: Host Says Personal Letters, the Tent and the Microphone Were Put Up for Sale
claims.claim: The host says there is not a piece of Charlie Kirk that they did not try to sell, citing personal letters he wrote, the tent he died beneath and the microphone he was holding.
claims.investigative_direction: Find listings, auctions or announcements of the letters, tent and microphone; identify who offered them.
claims.transcript_snippet: the tent that you died beneath, the microphone that you were holding.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Flew Her to Wyoming Where Ye Recorded His Album
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk flew her out to Wyoming where Kanye West recorded the album that contains Ghost Town.
claims.investigative_direction: Check 2018 listening-event coverage and travel records for Kirk and the host in Wyoming.
claims.transcript_snippet: And you remember when you flew me out to Wyoming where he recorded that.

claims.label: Host Says the Whole World Knows Charlie's Assassination Was Ordered by the Most Powerful People
claims.claim: The host says the whole world knows that Charlie Kirk's assassination was ordered by the most powerful people in the world.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to name the people and show the evidence; this is an assertion of fact with no document presented in the episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: The whole world knows that your assassination was ordered by the most powerful people in the world.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Wrote That He Would Have to Choose Between Loved Ones and His Mission
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk wrote that he would have to choose between those he loves and his mission, and that his death came early and he did nothing to stop it.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for the writing, its date and medium; compare with other Kirk messages the host has read.
claims.transcript_snippet: You were right when you wrote that you would have to choose between those you love and your mission.

claims.label: Host Clip Says She Will Never Unsee the Footage of Charlie's Shooting
claims.claim: A clip of the host played at the end of the episode says Charlie Kirk was her best friend and brother, that she will never unsee the footage of what she saw, and that there is no Candace without Charlie.
claims.investigative_direction: Date the clip; compare with the host's first statements after the shooting.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I will never unsee the footage of what I saw.

memes.canonical_term: Mad at You for Being Dead

occurrences.quote: Dear Charlie, um I'm really mad at you for being dead.
occurrences.context: Host opens the first journal entry with the running line.

occurrences.quote: Yeah, I'm still pretty mad at you for being dead
occurrences.context: Host closes the road trip passage by repeating the line from the opening entry.
